from_notes: Origin | Elevated submarine mountains (Arakan Yoma extension); volcanic Barren and Narcondam | Coral atolls
x: The Andaman and Nicobar Islands are an elevated portion of submarine mountains (the Arakan Yoma extension, raised by the collision of the Indian and Burma plates, i.e. tectonic), and some smaller ones such as Barren and Narcondam are volcanic. They were not formed by erosion of the mainland, so statement 3 is wrong.
source: OnlyIAS NCERT Indian Geography 03 p.18; NextGen Indian Geography - APPSC Exams 06 p.3-5
